caption: Piazza del Campo, Siena
composition: Shell-shaped piazza and Torre del Mangia · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the open curve of the Piazza del Campo at dawn, taking in the full sweep of the shell-shaped square. The slender Torre del Mangia rises at the right of the frame above the crenellated Palazzo Pubblico, while the arcaded palazzi curve around the left and center. The modelled 23 September 2026, 06:55 light is soft and rosy on the brick facades, with the street lamps still burning along the empty brick paving.
